passRule: A request passes when no hard check fails: no needed block is decided "not needed" (p <= 0.2) and no unrelated block is decided "needed" (p >= 0.8). Soft checks: needed blocks decided needed (>= 0.8), unrelated blocks decided not needed (<= 0.2), near misses not decided needed. The set passes when both requests pass. Bars are the gate's own: yes >= 0.8 keeps a block, no <= 0.2 lets the code spill it, anything between keeps it. Bodies are built by the product (advisory judge, predicate design).
